title: Serve the four linked license and privacy source documents
acceptance: The public LICENSE, NOTICE, ASSET-LICENSES.md and PRIVACY.md routes return their unchanged repository source bytes instead of the application shell.
The documents are readable as plain text and a required release check rejects missing or stale published copies.
